task: PBI 2 — Add Conversation storage and CRUD API
summary: Add an owned Conversation model with authenticated CRUD endpoints, validation, lifecycle handling, an Alembic migration, and isolated tests. No UI or triage integration.
outOfScope: Conversation triage or external model/provider calls
Applying migrations to the application or any shared database
validation: 14 Conversation API tests passed against disposable SQLite
11 Item regression tests passed against a separate unique disposable SQLite database
Full Alembic chain applied to a fresh disposable PostgreSQL 18 database through revision 828e4a07b99e
Alembic heads reports one head; alembic check reports only the unrelated PBI1 item.priority type drift
Ruff and test-runner shell syntax checks passed
stopConditions: Do not inspect or migrate the application database
Stop if an isolated disposable test database is not configured
Stop if a new product or privacy decision materially expands PBI2
decisions: Title maximum is 255 characters and transcript maximum is 10000 characters
Conversation data is deleted when its owner is deleted
Conversation access is owner-only, including for superusers
Transcript input is omitted from validation error details

plan.title: PBI 2: Add Conversation storage and CRUD API
plan.outcome: Add a first project-specific data resource: a Conversation model with CRUD API, ownership scoping, validation, and isolated test infrastructure. No UI is included.

scope.planning_session: No files changed or commands run. This plan is a reviewable document.
proposed_implementation_scope: Add Conversation SQLModel model with id, owner_id, title, transcript, created_at, updated_at
Enforce maximum lengths: title ≤ 255 chars, transcript ≤ 10,000 chars
Add Alembic migration to create conversations table
Implement authenticated CRUD endpoints: POST /conversations, GET /conversations, GET /conversations/{id}, PUT /conversations/{id}, DELETE /conversations/{id}
Scope all operations to the authenticated owner; deny cross-user access (superuser access denied unless explicitly approved)
User deletion cascades to Conversation deletion (consistent with Item pattern)
Add API response envelope matching existing pattern: ConversationPublic with data and count fields
Add Conversation model relationship in User (optional but recommended)
explicitly_out_of_scope: User deletion confirmation dialogs or UX
Authentication beyond existing patterns (e.g., OAuth2, SSO)
Any other data model or API changes not directly tied to Conversation

current_evidence_and_surface_map.sqlmodel_patterns: ItemBase, Item, User show ForeignKey + Relationship with ondelete="CASCADE" and cascade_delete=True. User has items: list[Item] with cascade_delete=True.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.ownership_scoping: items.py routes filter list by owner_id for non-superusers; read/update/delete check item.owner_id != current_user.id → 403. Creation sets owner_id from current_user.id.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.user_deletion: users.py DELETE endpoint checks user == current_user → 403; if not superuser, deletes all items owned by user (delete(Item).where(col(Item.owner_id) == user_id)), then deletes user.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.tests: test-isolated.sh uses TEST_DATABASE_URL env var, fails-closed if unset. Tests use pytest with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to unique SQLite file. conftest_isolated.py uses test_engine, init_test_db, drop_test_db.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.alembic: env.py uses SQLModel.metadata from app.models. New migration should use op.add_column and server_default.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.api_response_envelope: ItemsPublic uses {data: list[ItemPublic], count: int}. Conversation list should follow same pattern.
current_evidence_and_surface_map.test_patterns: test_items.py uses superuser_token_headers, normal_user_token_headers, client, db fixtures. test-isolated.sh runs tests/api/routes/test_items.py.

phases.name: Model & migration
steps: Define Conversation model in backend/app/models.py with id, owner_id, title, transcript, created_at, updated_at
Add title: str = Field(1, 255) and transcript: str = Field(1, 10000) with validation
Add Alembic migration in backend/app/alembic/versions/ with server_default for created_at and updated_at (or handle in app)
Update User model to optionally include conversations: list[Conversation] = Relationship(..., cascade_delete=True)

phases.name: API endpoints
steps: Add conversations.py route module in backend/app/api/routes/ with: POST /conversations → create_conversation (validate lengths, set owner_id = current_user.id), GET /conversations → list_conversations (filter by owner_id = current_user.id for non-superusers), GET /conversations/{id} → get_conversation (check ownership), PUT /conversations/{id} → update_conversation (validate lengths, check ownership), DELETE /conversations/{id} → delete_conversation (check ownership, delete item)
Use existing patterns: create_item, get_item, update_item, delete_item as templates

phases.name: Validation
steps: Add ConversationCreate and ConversationUpdate Pydantic schemas with title and transcript fields
Add ConversationPublic schema for responses
Add ConversationDelete response using Message model
Add length validation in service layer or Pydantic models

phases.name: Ownership & lifecycle
steps: All list/get/update/delete operations must check conversation.owner_id == current_user.id or current_user.is_superuser
User deletion (existing) already cascades to items; Conversation will cascade-delete with its owner (no new cascade needed if conversations relationship added to User)
If conversations relationship not added to User, cascade is handled via foreign key owner_id + ondelete="CASCADE" in migration

phases.name: Testing
steps: Add test_conversations.py to backend/tests/api/routes/
Use superuser_token_headers and normal_user_token_headers fixtures
Use test-isolated.sh pattern: ensure TEST_DATABASE_URL is set in test fixtures

Add tests for: valid create/update/delete by owner, 403 Forbidden for non-owner access, 404 Not Found for invalid IDs, length validation (e.g., title > 255 chars), owner deletion cascade (test item deletion when user deleted)

phases.name: Validation & acceptance
steps: Run test-isolated.sh with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to unique SQLite file
Verify all endpoint behaviors match acceptance criteria
Confirm migration applies cleanly to database
Confirm tests pass in isolated environment

risks_and_open_decisions.proposal: title ≤ 255 chars (matches Item.title), transcript ≤ 10,000 chars. Confirm with product.
CASCADE (consistent with Item pattern and existing User.delete behavior), but flag as a decision.
Deny superuser access to private Conversations unless explicitly approved. Flag as a decision.
Add updated_at with default datetime.now(UTC) and update on PUT. Flag as a decision.
Add conversations: list[Conversation] = Relationship(..., cascade_delete=True, back_populates="owner") to User model. Flag as a decision.
Ensure test-isolated.sh pattern is followed; may need to extend fixture to support new test files.

plan.validation: Run test-isolated.sh with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to unique SQLite file; verify all endpoint behaviors match acceptance criteria; confirm migration applies cleanly to database; confirm tests pass in isolated environment.
